labelling_protocol: rule_truth = ground_truth_defi(facts, sources) at T0 (point-in-time, pre-registered rules). realized = what happened by T0 + horizon_days; used only for rule calibration, never by the judge. IMPORTANT: 'facts' in this draft are read from post-mortems and therefore carry hindsight. Before any case is scored, facts and source states must be re-derived from chain state at t0_block via archive RPC, with a capsule per fact; until then status stays 'draft'.

cases.name: UST / Anchor collapse
cases.position: UST exposure via the Curve UST/3CRV metapool on Ethereum (Anchor as the yield source on Terra)

facts.gate_basis: reflexive backing: peg defended by minting the collateral token (LUNA); no exogenous reserve
facts.anomaly_basis: Anchor yield reserve being drawn down to subsidise ~20% deposit rate

realized.summary: UST lost its peg from ~7 May 2022 and did not recover; Terra halted.

stresses: false negative under a long clean history

cases.name: stETH discount during Celsius / 3AC deleveraging
cases.position: Unlevered stETH, small size relative to Curve stETH/ETH depth

facts.anomaly_basis: Curve stETH/ETH pool heavily imbalanced toward stETH; secondary discount of several percent; withdrawals not yet enabled

realized.summary: Mark-to-market drawdown only; discount closed once withdrawals were enabled (2023). A leveraged stETH loop at high LTV is a different case and would be labelled FLAG.

cases.name: Mango Markets oracle manipulation
cases.position: USDC deposit on Mango Markets v3

facts.gate_basis: collateral (MNGO) priced from thin spot markets: oracle manipulable at a cost below the borrowable amount

market_depth.note: historical depth for Solana must come from archived order-book/AMM snapshots; jupiter_quote is a placeholder

cases.notes: Solana: no reader in rpc.py yet (EVM only). Stays draft until a Solana account/AMM-snapshot reader exists; the label rests on oracle-vs-depth, which needs historical order-book or AMM state.

cases.name: CRV collateral concentration (single borrower)
cases.position: Stablecoin supplier to CRV-collateral lending markets (LlamaLend, Inverse, Fraxlend, UwU Lend)

facts.gate_basis: collateral size far above DEX exit depth for CRV
facts.concentration_basis: one borrower dominates CRV-collateral markets across venues; health factor near 1 on at least one venue; borrow rates extreme
facts.anomaly_basis: borrow APR on LlamaLend reported around 120%

realized.summary: CRV fell ~25% on 13 Jun 2024 and ~$140M of the positions were liquidated across four venues. Bad debt by venue: TO VERIFY before scoring.

cases.notes: Reconstruction 2026-10-01: in the LlamaLend CRV market (total debt $51.2M at block 20057708) the public address 0x7a16…5428 held $0.34M (0.67%). Concentration is not visible per ADDRESS; reports attribute positions to several wallets and to Fraxlend/Inverse/UwU. Kept as draft: needs an entity-level (address clustering) rule, which is an open methodological question.

cases.name: Stream Finance xUSD in curated lending vaults
cases.position: USDC supplier (directly or via a curated vault) to the Morpho USDC/xUSD market on Arbitrum

facts.gate_basis: structural absence of backing evidence: off-chain book run by one external manager, no attestation; recursive looping inflated footprint
facts.controls_basis: xUSD priced by an 'xUSD/USD' feed (0xdc0e…ede9) reporting issuer-side value: 1.248 thirty days before T0, 1.262 at T0, still 1.266 on 2025-11-06 when xUSD traded near $0.26. Not a constant, but a price the issuer reports, with no open par redemption and no verifiable backing. The automatic rule (constant price) does not cover this; label set by hand on the recorded evidence — see METHODOLOGY-DeFi.md §10.

realized.summary: Loss disclosed 4 Nov 2025 (~$93M); xUSD fell ~77% to ~$0.26; ~$285M of related exposure mapped; pools frozen.

cases.notes: Re-scoped 2026-10-01 to the Arbitrum market (Ethereum xUSD markets were empty at T0). Same market as H10: H09 tests the oracle/backing rule, H10 the concentration rule.
cases.label_source: manual: automatic rule returned controls_safe=True (feed not constant)

cases.name: Single-borrower xUSD market on Morpho (Arbitrum)
cases.position: USDC supplier to the Morpho USDC/xUSD market on Arbitrum (LLTV 91.5%), mostly funded by one curated vault

facts.gate_basis: collateral with no verifiable backing (see H09)
facts.concentration_basis: At 2025-10-27 (block 393757551): one address, 0x1597e4b7cf6d2877a1d690b6088668afdb045763, held 89.14% of the market's debt ($20.58M of $23.09M; utilization 88.2%). That position was closed before the collapse; the address that holds ~100% today (0x2D9C…551c) held ~3% at T0. Address set from the Morpho API, every amount read on chain at T0.
facts.controls_basis: xUSD valued by a fixed-ratio oracle without open par redemption
